desc.zh: 她是雷神之女，双刀「紫电」的主人。敌人尚未看清她的身影，便已倒在雷光之下。
desc.en: The Daughter of Raijin, wielding the twin blades Shiden; before foes can mark her form, they fall beneath the lightning.

story.zh: 立花直虎出身尼朋名门，因家中无男嗣，年幼时便破例继承家督，亲执双刀「紫电」领兵出阵。内战中立花家所在阵营战败、领地被没收，直虎自此下落不明。相传有带着鬼面的少女手持双刀，出没于战火未熄的乡野。她的刀光快过视线，雷鸣随刀而至，被劈中的邪物焦黑如炭。
story.en: Tachibana Naotora was born to a great house of Nippon. With no male heir in the family, she inherited the headship of the clan while still young – against all custom – and took the field in person, wielding the twin blades Shiden. When the side her house had taken in the civil war was defeated and its lands confiscated, Naotora vanished without a trace. Rumour tells of a girl in an oni mask, twin blades in hand, abroad in the countryside where the fires of war have not yet gone out. The gleam of her blades is quicker than sight, thunder arrives with every stroke, and the wicked things she cleaves are left scorched black as charcoal.
